membershipDecision.question: Do any of the 71 registered scenarios fall inside a family, and do the families need scenarios of their own minted in QUAR?
membershipDecision.answer: No existing register entry is a member; each family carries exactly one minted EAP-QUAR-NNN member.
membershipDecision.reasoningForNoExistingMember: The 71 registered scenarios are the `#####` headings of cognitive_line/004 §1-§3. That document states at line 12 that it defers exactly these questions and that 'No scenario below silently resolves those questions', and this domain's 004 Scope repeats the constraint for all seven. Grepping cognitive_line/004 for faulty_since_seq, LegacyClaimStatus, page size / batching, in-flight promotion, indirect dependents, RecallNotice and timing / side channel / leak returns hits only in that deferral note and in §4 itself — no §1-§3 scenario heading or Given/When/Then touches a family.

liftingSemantics.rule: 001 §5 rule 4 — a quarantine lifts only by a merged ADR amendment that names the family.
liftingSemantics.implementation: attemptLift(doc, familyId, amendments) is pure: it never mutates the caller's document. It refuses when no amendment names the family, refuses when a naming amendment is not merged (an unmerged amendment is a proposal, not a decision), and on refusal returns the document unchanged with memberStatus 'declared-untestable'. On a merged naming amendment it returns the document without the family and memberStatus 'proposed', matching 'the scenario re-enters the register as proposed'.
